entry_points.summary: Orchestrates multi-LLM code-quality review of a branch diff; writes P0-P4 findings to MR-REVIEW.md as a task-shaped promotion artifact consumable via /z-implement-all --tasks.
Propagates targeted plan amendments consistently across plan artifacts.
Coordinates parallel multi-dimensional code auditing and rubric checks; preserves REPORT.md evidence and promotes actionable findings into TASKS.md.
Read-only audit for existing SPEC/PLAN/TASKS artifacts; writes PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md and uses contextual route exits to /z-plan, /z-amend, or /z-maintain-docs.
Seeds plan definitions via parallel ideation models and anti-bias passes.

Heavy hypothesis-tournament debugging pipeline: 3-LLM 2-round adversarial hypothesis generation, ordinal Bayesian scoring, consensus-first ranking with forced outlier carve-out, 3-5 isolation rounds, fix-gate requires highest posterior and full evidence coverage. Single unified DEBUG.md artifact.
Applies small plan-free changes directly to source code under peer review.
Lightweight bug-fix command for the case where the user already has a diagnosis; single light-fix consult, inline implementation, non-negotiable Codex review, optional post-mortem.
Executes pending tasks from canonical TASKS.md or an explicit --tasks path using isolated implementer and reviewer subagents; compaction breakpoints fire at batch-settle boundaries.
Implements the next pending plan task under code review safety gates.
Surfaces project infrastructure suggestions from run event logs.
Initializes the two-tier human and LLM concept documentation system.
Drift-checks and refreshes stale or drifted concept documentation; --audit mode adds cross-LLM verification with a pre-consult compaction breakpoint at Phase 2.3.
Creates lightweight bug fix plans bypassing full subagent overhead.
Splits a large plan into parallel sub-planning sessions; usage-% guard removed; setup steps renumbered.
Executes the core planning pipeline creating spec, plan, and task files; usage-% guard removed; docs-staleness routes via route-decision flow.
Explores a codebase and charts its constraints before defining a plan.

Validates the complete set of generated code diffs against spec requirements and promotes accepted review findings into REVIEW-TASKS.md; supports HEAD-aware fast-forward resume from pre-Phase-4 state.
Safely mutates system plugin skill definitions.
Analyzes historical run logs to aggregate token metrics and run times.
Appends key lessons and edge case memories to concept documentation JSON.
Constructs rich semantic test-case plans to link within task items.

invariants: Every execution event must be routed to metrics.jsonl and per-run event logs.

Commands must resolve plan directories via scripts/plan-path.sh (plan_dir or resolve_plan_path), not by constructing z-harness/<slug> paths directly. New canonical path: ${Z_HARNESS_PLANS_DIR:-z-harness/plans}/<slug>/. Commands must try the new path first; on miss, resolve_plan_path falls back to the legacy z-harness/<slug>/ path and warns once per process (Z_HARNESS_LEGACY_WARNED guard) with the exact migration command: scripts/migrate-plan-layout.sh <slug>.

Review-family commands preserve evidence artifacts and promote only actionable findings into task-shaped artifacts. Spec gaps route through /z-amend; review-all must not directly mutate SPEC.md or canonical TASKS.md.

Planning-family route bails write route-decision.md, emit plan_route_decision with route_class/reason_codes/signals/confidence/classifier_used/artifact_path/route_chain/user_choice, present an AskUser handoff gate, and never auto-execute another command.
/z-implement-all compaction counters (tasks_since_pause, pause_clock_start) are in-memory ephemeral; they reset on every re-invocation. TASKS.md [x] count is the durable record.
/z-review-all state file (.review_state.json) is deleted unconditionally at end of Phase 6 so subsequent invocations always start fresh.
gotchas: Orchestrating large plans directly in the main thread is context-heavy; delegate to subagents.
Promoted review artifacts such as REVIEW-TASKS.md and MR-REVIEW.md are applied with /z-implement-all --tasks <path>, not by appending directly to canonical TASKS.md.

Route classes are distinct: primary targets are /z-do, /z-plan-light, /z-plan, /z-plan-split, /z-brainstorm, and /z-research; contextual exits are /z-audit-plan, /z-fix, /z-debug, /z-amend, and /z-maintain-docs.
/z-audit-plan is contextual only and requires existing plan artifacts; when no plan exists it routes to /z-plan instead of auditing.

Z_HARNESS_PAUSE_AT_PCT and usage_pause guard were removed from /z-plan and /z-plan-split. Docs-staleness in /z-plan now routes via the standard route-decision flow (Z_HARNESS_DOC_STALENESS_THRESHOLD, default 20%).
/z-implement-all --tasks=<path> bypasses slug discovery and MANIFEST validation; --ack and --force-partial are no-ops in this mode. BASE is derived from the directory containing the tasks file.
/z-review-all Phase 3.7 breakpoint always fires; if the user picks 'Pause for /clear', no state file is written and Phase 3.7 will re-prompt on the next invocation.

/z-maintain-docs --audit state file is at docs/llm/.maintain_docs_audit_state.json (not slug-scoped). Fast-forward triggers only when stale concept set is identical to stale_concepts_at_ack; any set change re-prompts.
